1879053069.Skill_Desc: Your very presence inspires those around you to perform better in combat.

1879059853.Skill_Desc: Makes three deadly attacks.\n\nThis attack can only be evaded; it will never miss, be parried by or blocked by an on level opponent.

1879060621.Skill_Desc: A quick swipe that will strike multiple enemies.

1879060749.Skill_Desc: Strike hard with your staff. If your pet is flanking the enemy, you will deal bonus damage.

1879061005.Skill_Desc: Disappear from before the enemy's eyes.\n\nBriefly improves Stealth. Using this skill will not break Stealth.

1879064077.Skill_Desc: Makes a full AoE attack, which stuns your opponents.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Stun replaced with a mount speed debuff</rgb>

1879064333.Skill_Desc: Stun an enemy to enable a Fellowship Manoeuvre for your group.

1879072525.Skill_Desc: You are hardier than most and can recover from most crowd control effects.

1879073293.Skill_Desc: Deals damage even after the initial strike.\n\nThe bleed deals more damage while Stealthed.

1879073677.Skill_Desc: When your target has less than 50% of their morale, you can make an extremely damaging attack with an increased chance to critical.

1879091725.Skill_Desc: Briefly increases the defence of your Shield-brother.

1879094797.Skill_Desc: A flare in the sky dazes enemies, but damage will break their stupor.

1879099277.Skill_Desc: You can instruct someone how to play the theorbo.

1879115149.Skill_Desc: Power loss over time effect and reduces in and out of combat power regeneration to 0 for 30 seconds. The prospects of victory against Amarthiel seem slim, sapping the player of power.

1879145101.Skill_Desc: Escape from danger and travel to a nearby rally point.\n\nWhile in PvMP areas, this skill cannot be used in combat.

1879146125.Skill_Desc: Creates a warded circle in which you and your allies take reduced damage.

1879186701.Skill_Desc: A damaging shot that also restores the Hunter's Morale.

1879198349.Skill_Desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879200653.Skill_Desc: Your hatchling injects your target with poison, causing severe lethargy.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Consumes Venomous Haze to increase incoming damage by 5% for 30s.</rgb>

1879208717.Skill_Desc: Essence of Toad has a million and one uses. Whether it's a troublesome enemy, an annoying friend, or a beautiful woman who's out of your league, in the end all glory will be yours.\n\nWill cause nearby players to faint.

1879214605.Skill_Desc:
Wardens find strength in the sure knowledge that they are fighting to defend the defenceless.
Drains significant morale from nearby enemies over time to heal the Warden.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879232781.Skill_Desc: Hardships are forgotten and spirits are lifted by such writings. This heal over time stacks with itself. -1% Power cost per Healing Attunement.

1879239565.Skill_Desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879241485.Skill_Desc: A strike that instantly heals the Morale of nearby Fellows, and also grants a Heal-over-time.

1879241997.Skill_Desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline turns your focus to steering the course of battle while maintaining your ability to protect allies from enemy assault.

1879243917.Skill_Desc: You make an attack which allows you to brace yourself against counterattack, increasing your Morale by a small amount. Your Morale will increase even if this attack is avoided.

1879251341.Skill_Desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Snowbourn in eastern Rohan.

1879301901.Skill_Desc: Calls forth the Standard of Valour, dealing damage to enemies while increasing the Morale healed to nearby allies.

1879307149.Skill_Desc: Summons a spotted shrew to brighten your day.
1879307149.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Spring Festival by participating in the Flowers Event.

1879315085.Skill_Desc: You consume some of your Wrath to regain some Morale in the heat of battle.

1879332621.Skill_Desc: Summons a distant cousin from the Stoors to keep you company.
1879332621.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from participating in the story of Bingo Boffin. May be bartered for in Bree-land.

1879343757.Skill_Desc: A hard-won steed from the 10-year Anniversary Festival.
1879343757.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available by finishing one card for each year in the special 10-year Anniversary Event.

1879344397.Skill_Desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879389709.Skill_Desc: Brings out a little brown pig to keep you company.
1879389709.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Vales of Anduin.

1879392269.Skill_Desc: A steed representing the Great Alliance of Elves and Men who faced Sauron at the end of the Second Age.
1879392269.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Minas Morgul Collector's Edition or Ultimate Fan Bundle.

1879408653.Skill_Desc: A proud steed of Ringló Vale.
1879408653.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from Hobbit Presents as a special Yule in Midsummer Gift.

1879411085.Skill_Desc: A little squirrel who would like to see the world with you.
1879411085.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter from the March on Gundabad Quartermaster.

1879457549.Skill_Desc:
A series of impossibly fast attacks strike your opponents.

This skill will consume any War Cry, Brink of Victory, Surety of Death, or Desolation damage over time effects on your targets, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879483277.Skill_Desc: Bring down your weight with great force upon your foe.

1879506573.Skill_Desc: Target the earth and pull forth a pillar of ice that sheds damaging ice shards to all nearby.

1879506829.Skill_Desc: Beguile your target and leave them bleeding with deep wounds.

1879515021.Skill_Desc: Summons a bold and mischievous monkey to accompany you on your travels.
1879515021.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Acquired from Jaunty Patron's Simple, Enhanced, or Luxuriant Coffers.

1879527437.Skill_Desc: Channel the power of the gem to cleanse the target of the TBD Curse. This power will also harm the user.
